title: lobelia baumannii var. kummeriae
intro: Lobelia baumannii var. kummeriae, commonly known as Kummer's lobelia, is a plant species within the Campanulaceae family, native to the Himalayas. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, and is known for its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation, and acting as an expectorant and bronchodilator. The therapeutic actions of Kummer's lobelia include its ability to relax muscles, reduce spasms, and act as a sedative, which can help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily alkaloids, including lobeline, which is believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
